title: Degree Planner Constraint Spec v0.1
description: The contract between the NL translation layer and the CP-SAT solver. The LLM emits an instance of this; the solver consumes it. Nothing else crosses this boundary.

mode.description: term = pick sections for one upcoming term. plan = assign courses to future terms through graduation. Some constraint types are only valid in one mode.

target_term.description: Required when mode=term. Term code, e.g. '2027SP'.

clarifications.description: Questions the LLM wants answered before or after solving. Empty array is normal.

restatement.description: One or two sentences in plain English summarizing what the system understood. Shown to the user before solving so they can catch mistranslations.

out_of_scope.description: Anything the user asked for that has no representation in this schema. Logged as roadmap input; surfaced honestly to the user.

id.description: Unique within the spec, e.g. 'c1'. Used as the CP-SAT assumption literal so infeasibility analysis can name the offending constraint.

params.description: Shape depends on type. See the reference doc; validate per-type in application code (zod/pydantic), not in this schema.

enforcement.description: hard = must hold, filters the search space. soft = scored in the objective, can be violated at a cost.

weight.description: 1-5 importance. Used for soft-constraint scoring AND for ranking which constraints to suggest relaxing when infeasible. On hard constraints, weight is not used in the objective but IS used to order relaxation suggestions.

weight_source.description: Where the weight came from. Drives whether the UI should ask the user to confirm it.

confidence.description: LLM's confidence it understood this constraint correctly, 0-1. Below ~0.7 should trigger a clarification or a highlighted chip in the restatement UI.

source_text.description: The exact span of the user's message this came from. Powers the editable-chip restatement UI and makes debugging trivial.

data_dependency.description: Flags constraints that rely on data which may be missing or estimated for a given school. Solver degrades gracefully and the UI warns.

constraint_id.description: Which constraint this question is about, if any.

options.description: Suggested answers for a tappable UI. Optional.

blocking.description: true = do not solve until answered. false = solve now, ask alongside results.
